title: Limited Depth
description: Failing to appeal to an underlying cause, and instead simply appealing to membership in a category.  In other words, simply asserting what you are trying to explain without actually explaining anything.
logical_form:
*Claim X is made about Y.*
*Claim X is true because Y is a member of category Z.*

examples.example: *My dog goes through our garbage because he is a dog.*
examples.explanation: We know your dog is a dog, but what about him being a dog makes him go through the garbage?  By referring to your dog as a member of the category “dog”, this fails to explain anything.

examples.example: *Mormons are really, really nice because they go to Mormon church.*
examples.explanation: *[Question begging](https://www.logicallyfallacious.com/logicalfallacies/Begging-the-Question)* aside, simply stating that Mormons are a member of the group, “Mormon churchgoers” does not explain why they are nice.  A reasonable explanation would need to include a valid causal relationship between niceness and Mormon-church-going.

exceptions:
At times, limited depth can be used as a shorthand when assumptions are made that no deeper explanation is needed.

*I need oxygen because I am human!*

**Fun Fact:** Mormons getting their own planet in the Mormon afterlife is actually a misconception, not official Mormon doctrine.
references: Farha, B. (2013). *Pseudoscience and Deception: The Smoke and Mirrors of Paranormal Claims*. University Press of America.
description_et: Suutmatus apelleerida algpõhjusele ja selle asemel apelleerida lihtsalt kategooria kuulumisele.  Teisisõnu, lihtsalt kinnitades seda, mida proovite selgitada, ilma tegelikult midagi selgitamata.
logical_form_et:
*Väide X on tehtud Y kohta.*
*Väide X on tõene, kuna Y on Z-kategooria liige.*
exceptions_et:
Mõnikord võib piiratud sügavust kasutada stenogrammina, kui eeldatakse, et põhjalikumat selgitust pole vaja.

*Ma vajan hapnikku, sest olen inimene!*

**Lõbus fakt:** Mormoonide oma planeedi saamine mormoonide hauataguses elus on tegelikult eksiarvamus, mitte ametlik mormoonide õpetus.

examples_et.example: *Minu koer läheb meie prügist läbi, sest ta on koer.*
examples_et.explanation: Me teame, et teie koer on koer, aga mis siis, kui ta on koer, sunnib ta prügist läbi minema?  Viidates oma koerale kui kategooria "koer" liikmele, ei selgita see midagi.
examples_et.original_example: *My dog goes through our garbage because he is a dog.*
examples_et.original_explanation: We know your dog is a dog, but what about him being a dog makes him go through the garbage?  By referring to your dog as a member of the category “dog”, this fails to explain anything.

examples_et.example: *Mormoonid on tõesti väga toredad, sest nad käivad mormoonide kirikus.*
examples_et.explanation: *[Küsimuste kerjamine](https://www.logicallyfallacious.com/logicalfallacies/Begging-the-Question)*, öeldes lihtsalt, et mormoonid on grupi liikmed, ei selgita „mormoonide kirikuskäijad”, miks nad on toredad.  Mõistlik selgitus peaks sisaldama kehtivat põhjuslikku seost kenaduse ja mormoonide kirikus käimise vahel.
